title: Simpler learner arch labels
details: The four learner arches now use universal plain-language labels: Time, Course, Learn and Test
The underlying arch routes are unchanged, so Time still opens TOC, Course still opens KSB/AC coverage, Learn still opens OTJ/GLH and Test keeps the existing EPA/ARP/Units route
The post-evidence 'Did you learn anything?' flow now saves automatically to GLH for NVQ learners and continues to save to OTJ for Standards learners
NVQ GLH entries keep the reflection, duration, date and evidence context and refresh the learner's GLH progress
Camera, evidence saving, Section E navigation and qualification mapping are unchanged
summary: Evia v154 simplifies the arches to Time, Course, Learn and Test and includes the NVQ GLH save fix.
